summary: Seen from outside, the host climbs out through the kitchen window just as the guest opens the kitchen door behind him, walks in and grabs him by the jacket.
framing: Exterior view looking straight in through the open window; the white window frame fills the screen, lavender house wall around it. Host in extreme close foreground, guest small in the background doorway. Static.

cast.visible: face (cropped at top right until 778), one arm, one leg and shoe, coming through the window
cast.costume: light-blue suit, lilac shirt, orange-pink tie (no apron)

cast.visible: waist up, in the doorway at the back of the kitchen, from 774
cast.costume: navy suit, white shirt, red tie, red pocket square

props: window frame and sill (foreground, fills frame)
purple panelled kitchen door on the far wall, left; hinged on its right side, opens into the kitchen; dark blue room beyond

beats.action: leaning out of the window at right, face cropped by the top-right of frame (nose, mouth, chin visible); screen-right hand grips the right window jamb, other hand reaches out over the sill at lower centre, grey shoe sole just appearing above the sill
kitchen door in the background is closed
shoe sole rises and pushes out over the sill toward camera, reaching hand slides further left; head sinks slowly into frame
door starts to swing open into the kitchen (left edge moves right, dark gap appears at left)
head lowers so one eye is in frame, looking down at where he is stepping; shoe and hand keep advancing
appears in the door gap at far left, facing right, only a sliver of face and suit visible
half visible beside the half-open door, looking right toward the host, mouth closed
big pose change: head and hair drop fully into frame, tilted down 3/4 left; trouser leg swings across the bottom of the frame, shoe drops to bottom centre, reaching hand large at left edge
stands in the fully open doorway, one hand on the door edge, lids low, looking at the host

leg fully over the sill (knee and thigh fill the bottom of frame, shoe gone below frame), reaching hand at bottom-left corner, fingers of other hand still on the right jamb; eyes wide looking down-left
steps into the kitchen toward the host, raises his screen-right hand palm-out at chest height
lids half lower, pupils slide to the far left (looking back over his shoulder toward the guest)
leans forward and reaches his arm out toward the host's back, hand open
eyes half open, pupils at far left, brow line slanted
hand closes on the back of the host's jacket; mouth opens
eyes snap wide open, small pupils at lower left; freezes in this pose to the end of the shot
arm held straight out gripping the host's jacket, lids half down, mouth moving as if speaking, to the end of the shot

notes: 777->778 is a large pose pop on the host (and the door jumps from half to fully open), but the window frame and wall are identical, so it is not a cut. Camera confirmed static. The guest's mouth is animated open/moving from 786 to 795 although script.json has no line in this shot. Animated on twos.
